desc: Swipe with one finger to turn the camera. Pinch to zoom. On a computer, drag the view or hold the arrow keys.
title: Look around

desc: Tap any clear ground and walk a few steps. Tap Run to travel faster; your energy recovers while walking or resting.
title: Take your first steps

desc: A mysterious man is calling you over from the square. Find out where you are—and why he brought you here.
title: The crossing keeper

desc: Open Bag in the navigation bar. Tap a material to highlight it, then tap another item or a world target. Press and hold any item for Use and its other actions.
title: Your belongings

desc: Open the Skills tab. Each skill has its own level and XP, including Attack, Strength, Defense and Hitpoints.
title: Your skills

desc: Rowan sends you to Arcanist Elowen inside the magic school in the island’s southeast. Open the door and walk in.
title: Carry Firstlight’s signal

desc: Equip Elowen’s staff using the Magic icon, then attack the practice dummy. Each spell uses relics and trains your Magic level.
title: Shape the signal

desc: Elowen sends you to Smith Orin beside the island’s forge. He teaches both Mining and Smithing.
title: Visit the smith

desc: Mine one copper ore and one tin ore in the yard. Both rocks can be mined at level 1.
title: Mine copper and tin

desc: Tap copper or tin ore in your bag, then tap the furnace. Choose the bronze bar recipe to combine both ores.
title: Smelt a bronze bar

desc: Tap your bronze bar, then tap the practice anvil. Choose Dagger in the smithing menu. Your bag stays visible as you work.
title: A blade made by your hands

desc: Orin sends you to Captain Vale at the training yard.
title: Protect the stores

desc: Open Equipment, then tap the bronze dagger in the bag beside it to equip it.
title: Equip your bronze dagger

desc: Captain Vale will give you a wooden training sword and shield.
title: A better practice weapon

desc: Equip both the wooden training sword and wooden shield from your bag. Keep your bronze dagger; you made it yourself.
title: Prepare for practice

desc: With your wooden sword and shield equipped, tap the training dummy. Choose Attack, Strength, Defense or balanced training using the selector.
title: Practice your attacks

desc: Go through the gate beside Vale and defeat a giant rat inside the pen. The gate closes behind you. Tap Eat if your health gets low.
title: Enter the rat pen

desc: Return to Captain Vale for a shortbow and arrows. He will teach you to fight across the low fence.
title: Learn ranged combat

desc: Equip the shortbow, then equip the arrows in your ammunition slot. Arrows left in your bag cannot be fired.
title: Equip your bow and arrows

desc: Stand outside the rat pen and attack a giant rat with your shortbow. Stay within bow range. Low fences stop feet, but arrows and spells can pass over them. Defeat a rat to complete the lesson.
title: Shoot across the fence

desc: Collect the coins and bones where the rat fell. Each tap takes the next item; keep the bones for Keeper Sera.
title: Pick up the drops

desc: Vale sends you to Forester Ash beside the timber yard to learn how to make camp.
title: Fill the crossing stores

desc: Tap the marked tree. Your axe is carried with you; gathering trains Woodcutting.
title: Cut your first log

desc: Find Fisher Nell at Stillwater, just west of the village.
title: Follow Ash’s directions

desc: Tap the highlighted fishing spot. Your catch goes into your bag as raw food.
title: Net some shrimp

desc: Stay beside Fisher Nell. Hold a log in your bag and choose Light fire on clear ground. If you need another log, chop the tree beside her.
title: Light a fire beside Nell

desc: Tap raw shrimp in your bag to highlight it, then tap the fire you lit beside Nell. You will walk to that fire and cook one shrimp.
title: Cook with Nell

desc: Nell sends you to Cook Bram inside the kitchen on the island’s eastern lane. He will supply a new recipe.
title: Food for a new wayfarer

desc: Bram has given you flour and water. Tap the flour to highlight it, then tap the jug of water to mix bread dough.
title: Mix your bread dough

desc: Tap bread dough in your bag to highlight it, then tap the range inside the kitchen to bake bread.
title: Bake at the range

desc: Try Eat with your cooked bread or shrimp. Food restores health. If your health is full, keep that food for a fight.
title: Food for the road

desc: Bram sends you to Banker Ada inside Firstlight Bank to the north. Open the bank door and walk inside.
title: Supplies that travel with you

desc: Talk to Ada and open your bank. Deposit an item from your bag. Stored items persist with your character.
title: Store a supply

desc: Withdraw an item from your bank. Worn equipment stays separate from stored supplies.
title: Take it back

desc: Ada sends you to Keeper Sera at the shrine in the island’s southwest. Worship and spirits are taught together.
title: The First Accord

desc: Tap bones in your bag to bury them for Worship XP. Sera can provide practice bones if you need them.
title: Honour the fallen

desc: Speak to Keeper Sera and choose Fire, Water, Air or Earth. Your first companion joins your party with an elemental awakening.
title: Choose the bond you will carry

desc: Return to Rowan. The freedom fighters have prepared you. Ask him to open the one-way crossing to Briarhaven on the mainland.
title: Carry the accord to Briarhaven
